description: Image Description: The image shows three goats standing on a snowy surface. They are in front of a small wooden structure that looks like a shed or shelter. The background includes a red brick wall and more piled snow. The goats have varying coat colors; one is predominantly brown, another is a mix of white and brown, and the third is mostly white with some gray markings. The setting appears to be a farm or rural area, with the goats appearing calm and stationary.
